info.title: Lumintra Backend API
info.description: REST API documentation for Lumintra LED Car Decoration Platform

tags.name: Shopping Cart
tags.description: Endpoints for customers to view and manage their active shopping cart

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Endpoints for customers to check out cart items and manage purchase orders

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Endpoints for user authentication and account registration

get.description: Identity comes from the authenticated JWT subject. Returns current database profile and roles; credentials and security fields are excluded.

put.description: Replace name, phone and avatar for the authenticated account. Null or blank phone/avatar clears that profile value. Account email, credentials and roles cannot be changed.

400.description: Invalid name, phone, avatar or JSON

post.summary: Checkout selected cart items to create an order
post.description: Creates a PENDING_PAYMENT order from selected cart items, deducts physical LED hardware stock atomically, snapshots order items and delivery information (when physical goods are present), initializes SEPAY payment intent, and removes only the checked-out cart items.

201.description: Order created successfully and awaiting payment confirmation

400.description: Bad Request: validation failure, invalid cart item, missing delivery address for physical goods, unavailable product, already owned digital product, or insufficient LED stock

value.message: One or more selected cart items do not exist or do not belong to your cart.
Delivery address or shipping details are required for physical orders.
Insufficient LED hardware stock for one or more selected items.
Customer already owns one or more selected digital products.

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

404.description: Not Found: deliveryAddressId does not exist or belongs to another customer

post.summary: Add item to active shopping cart
post.description: Adds a published product to the authenticated customer's active cart, initializing the cart if absent, enforcing digital item limits/ownership, and accumulating LED/bundle quantities within available stock.

200.description: Item added and updated shopping cart returned successfully

400.description: Bad Request: validation failure, unavailable product, already owned digital product, digital quantity limit exceeded, or insufficient stock

value.message: Product is not published for purchase.
Customer already owns this digital product.
Digital products cannot exceed a quantity of 1 in the cart.
Requested LED quantity exceeds available stock.

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

post.description: Validates the 6-digit OTP code sent to customer's email during registration. Upon successful validation, transitions customer account status from PENDING_VERIFICATION to ACTIVE.

200.description: Email verified successfully; account is now ACTIVE

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains invalid fields, invalid/expired OTP, or account already verified

404.description: User account not found for provided email

429.description: Too many failed OTP attempts: maximum retry threshold exceeded

value.message: Maximum OTP attempts reached. Please request a new code.

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.description: Public endpoint. Validates 6-digit OTP code against Redis, updates and hashes the new password, revokes all existing sessions/refresh tokens across all devices, and logs an audit event if internal staff.

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains missing/invalid fields, weak password, or invalid/expired OTP

details.message: Password must be 8-72 characters long, contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character, with no whitespace

404.description: User account not found with the provided email address

429.description: Maximum OTP verification attempts reached: token invalidated

example.message: Maximum OTP attempts reached. Please request a new code.

post.description: Re-generates and emails a new 6-digit verification OTP to a customer in PENDING_VERIFICATION status. Enforces a 60-second cooldown and a maximum of 3 resends per 24 hours.

202.description: Verification email request accepted for delivery

400.description: Validation failed: invalid request payload or account already verified

404.description: User account not found for provided email

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: cooldown period active (60s) or maximum resend quota reached (3 attempts)

value.message: Please wait 60 seconds before requesting another email.
Maximum resend attempts reached for this email.

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.description: Registers a new customer account using email and password. Upon successful registration, the account is created in PENDING_VERIFICATION status and a verification OTP is dispatched to the user's email address.

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains invalid fields or passwords do not match

409.description: Conflict: The email address is already registered

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.summary: Refresh access and refresh JWT tokens
post.description: Validates the provided refresh token against active stored sessions (Redis or DB fallback), revokes the single-use token immediately (Token Rotation), and issues a new access and refresh token pair.

200.description: Tokens renewed successfully with new access and refresh token pair

400.description: Validation failed: refresh token is missing or blank

401.description: Unauthorized: Invalid, expired, unrecognized, or already consumed refresh token, or account suspended/deleted

value.message: Refresh token is unrecognized or already consumed.

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure during token refresh

post.summary: Log out user session and invalidate tokens
post.description: Logs out the authenticated user by invalidating the provided refresh token, revoking all refresh tokens associated with the account across devices, and blacklisting the JWT access token in Redis until its natural expiration.

204.description: Session successfully terminated and tokens invalidated. No content returned.

400.description: Validation failed: Malformed request body or missing refresh token

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure during logout

post.description: Authenticates user credentials using email and password. Upon success, returns access and refresh tokens. Failed attempts are tracked (lockout occurs after 5 failed attempts).

400.description: Validation failed: request payload contains missing or invalid fields

423.description: Locked: Account is locked for 15 minutes due to consecutive failed attempts

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure

post.summary: Authenticate or register via Google OAuth2
post.description: Authenticates a customer using a Google ID token. If the user account does not exist, an account and customer profile are automatically created with ACTIVE status and email verified. Returns access and refresh JWT tokens.

200.description: User authenticated successfully via Google OAuth2

400.description: Validation failed: Google ID token is missing or invalid

401.description: Unauthorized: Invalid or expired Google ID token, or Google login rejected for staff/inactive accounts

value.message: Google login is not supported for staff accounts.

423.description: Locked: Account is temporarily locked due to consecutive failed attempts

500.description: Internal server error: Unexpected system failure during Google authentication

post.description: Public endpoint. Sends a six-digit code valid for five minutes if the email exists. The first three requests in 24 hours are allowed; the fourth locks requests for 24 hours. Unknown email returns the same acknowledgement and has the same request limits.

example.message: Password reset requests are locked for 24 hours.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated history of orders owned by the authenticated CUSTOMER, sorted by createdAt descending with optional status and UTC date-range filters.

400.description: Bad Request: invalid pagination, status enum, date format, or fromDate after toDate

details.message: fromDate must not be after toDate

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

get.description: Retrieves full details of an order owned by the authenticated CUSTOMER, including snapshotted line items (with previewGifUrl for CHARACTER items), optional AhaMove delivery tracking, and active SePay VietQR retry info or confirmed payment summary.

400.description: Bad Request: invalid or non-positive order id path parameter

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

404.description: Not Found: order does not exist or belongs to another customer

get.description: Retrieves the authenticated customer's active shopping cart with real-time product base prices, item subtotals, and availability flags. Initializes an empty cart if none exists.

401.description: Unauthorized: missing, expired, or invalid JWT authentication token

403.description: Forbidden: account type is not CUSTOMER (e.g. EMPLOYEE accounts are denied)

UpdateCurrentProfileRequest.description: Replace editable profile fields. Null or blank phone/avatar clears the profile value; name is required.

phone.description: 8 to 15 digits with an optional leading plus. Null or blank clears the phone.

avatar.description: Absolute HTTP(S) avatar URL, maximum 255 characters. Null or blank clears the profile override, falling back to the account avatar.

field.description: The request field that caused the error

message.description: Description of the validation failure on this field

status.description: HTTP status code matching the response

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the error occurred

traceId.description: Unique trace ID for support and diagnostics

details.description: List of structured problem details related to the error

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

CurrentProfileResponse.description: Current account profile; only public profile fields are serialized

name.description: Full name; null when not completed

avatar.description: Profile avatar URL, falling back to the account avatar

roles.description: Current database role names without ROLE_ prefix

CheckoutRequest.description: Request payload for checking out selected shopping cart items into an order

cartItemIds.description: Non-empty list of selected cart item IDs belonging to the authenticated customer

deliveryAddressId.description: Saved address ID from customer's address book (required for physical orders unless shippingDetails is supplied)

shippingDetails.description: Inline shipping delivery details with GPS coordinates (alternative to deliveryAddressId for physical orders)

ShippingDetailsRequest.description: Inline shipping recipient and coordinate details

fullAddress.example: 123 Nguyen Hue, Ben Nghe, District 1, HCMC

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

CheckoutResponse.description: Order checkout summary with initialized payment intent details

paymentGateway.description: Payment gateway used for the transaction

status.description: Initial order status awaiting payment confirmation

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when unpaid checkout reservation expires

AddCartItemRequest.description: Request payload for adding a product to the authenticated customer's shopping cart

productId.description: Identifier of the product to add

quantity.description: Quantity of the product to add (minimum 1)

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

CartItemResponse.description: Line item in the shopping cart with real-time pricing and availability status

cartItemId.description: Unique identifier of the cart item

unitPrice.description: Current unit price sourced from product base_price

subtotal.description: Line item subtotal calculated as unitPrice * quantity

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether this item can currently be purchased

unavailableReason.description: Machine-readable unavailability reason when isAvailable is false; null when available

addedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the item was added to cart

CartResponse.description: Active shopping cart response for the authenticated customer

cartId.description: Unique identifier of the shopping cart

items.description: List of items currently in the shopping cart

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the cart was last updated

VerifyEmailRequest.description: Request payload for email verification using 6-digit OTP code

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Payload for resetting account password using OTP

newPassword.description: New account password. Must be 8-72 characters long, containing at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character (@$!%*?&)

confirmPassword.description: Optional password confirmation. If supplied, must match newPassword exactly

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

message.example: Password has been reset successfully. Please log in with your new password.

ResendVerificationRequest.description: Request payload for resending the verification OTP email

RegisterRequest.description: Payload for registering a new customer account

email.description: Customer email address. Must be unique and valid format

password.description: Account password. Must be 8-72 characters long, containing at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character (@$!%*?&)

confirmPassword.description: Password confirmation. Must match password field exactly

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

id.description: Unique ID of the created user account

accountType.description: Account type assigned to the user

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Refresh token request payload containing the single-use refresh token

refreshToken.description: Signed JWT refresh token previously issued upon login or token renewal

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

LoginResponse.description: JWT authentication response containing access and refresh tokens

accessToken.description: Signed JWT access token for authenticating protected requests

refreshToken.description: Signed JWT refresh token for renewing access tokens

expiresIn.description: Access token lifespan in seconds (15 minutes = 900s)

LogoutRequest.description: User logout request payload containing the refresh token to be revoked

refreshToken.description: Refresh token to be invalidated and revoked upon logout

GoogleLoginRequest.description: Google OAuth2 login request payload containing the Google ID token

idToken.description: Raw ID token (JWT) issued by Google OAuth2 Identity Provider

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

ForgotPasswordResponse.description: Generic acknowledgement that does not reveal whether an account exists

message.example: If the email is registered, a password reset code has been sent.

ProductFilterRequest.description: Filter parameters for browsing products in store catalog

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

OrderFilterRequest.description: Query parameters for listing and filtering the authenticated customer's order history

status.description: Filter by exact order lifecycle status

fromDate.description: Filter orders created on or after this ISO-8601 date (UTC)

toDate.description: Filter orders created on or before this ISO-8601 date (UTC)

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

OrderSummaryItem.description: Summary card of a customer purchase order

totalAmount.description: Final order payable amount in VND

totalItems.description: Total number of distinct order line items (COUNT of order_item)

primaryProductName.description: Display name of the primary (first) product in the order

primaryProductThumbnail.description: Thumbnail image URL of the primary (first) product in the order

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC payment expiration timestamp (populated only when status is PENDING_PAYMENT)

meta.description: Optional metadata for pagination, async jobs, or supplementary info

DeliveryDetail.description: Snapshotted recipient shipping details and live carrier tracking status

fullAddress.example: Saigon Hi-Tech Park, Thu Duc City, HCMC

OrderDetailResponse.description: Detailed purchase order view including line items, optional delivery tracking, and payment status/retry info

subtotal.description: Sum of snapshotted line item subtotals in VND

shippingFee.description: Shipping fee applied to this order in VND

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC payment expiration timestamp (populated when status is PENDING_PAYMENT)

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the order was created

items.description: Ordered line items with immutable unit price snapshots

delivery.description: Snapshotted recipient address and AhaMove tracking details (null for digital-only orders)

payment.description: Latest payment transaction confirmation or active SePay VietQR retry instructions

OrderItemDetail.description: Snapshotted line item within an order

previewGifUrl.description: Preview GIF animation URL (populated for CHARACTER products)

unitPrice.description: Snapshotted unit price at checkout time in VND

subtotal.description: Snapshotted line subtotal (unitPrice * quantity) in VND

paymentContent.description: Bank transfer memo content required for SePay matching (active PENDING_PAYMENT only)
